text.9f8c4648575e319627ac: Three early years assume active/billable capacity ramps, then ten-year growth fade; 2026 $3.2 bn is a forecast midpoint. ARR, RPO and TCV do not establish revenue, nor a 15/20-year durable advantage. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
text.e3326037d8c156457803: 18% by year 3 is an unproven operating-leverage assumption. Adjusted EBITDA and a server-life extension from four to five years do not prove economic replacement cost or mature EBIT.
text.2cd8451470a75d4bc682: Physical/refresh capital, advances and margin mature independently. Advance balance policy reaches 25% of revenue in 2034 (year 8); year-7/year-8 negative movements are cash uses of 1,986.521/5,056.518 USD m. End-2036 advances remain 22,575.825 USD m. The fixed first-three-year net investment is 11,100/10,100/9,900 USD m, not a free-growth S:C.
text.80ecc418ce539e55e6ab: Tax: 25% tax on positive EBIT is a normalized assumption; no immediate cash benefit for losses. The young post-divestment perimeter and acquisitions limit historical tax comparability.
text.490321d486b8e50f929c: Discount rate: The -2.5/+2.5 pp band around 15.5% matches source 13/18% WACC. Zero retains selected financing/competitive risk. It is not a substitute for unavailable funding, default or dilution, and cannot make an infeasible cash schedule financeable.
text.173b5898106f5cf72708: Terminal policy: 2.5% growth and 12% terminal ROIC require 20.833% terminal NOPAT reinvestment and leave ROIC below 15.5% WACC. The conditional neutral transition is 2.5% after explicit advance normalization; do not erase remaining advances or add an invented terminal credit.
text.be09a28f7cbbe2de3cfe: Uncertainty: Margin and WACC have bounded subjective triangular stress distributions. Growth and investment stay fixed because the selected customer-advance obligations must co-move with revenue in a component-aware model.
text.ff74c6d3d0cae166d192: Five explicit early years cover contracts, 2027–30 fab commissioning and the selected price reset, followed by normalization to year 10. Retain the final explicit 2.5% growth and separate 2% terminal growth; do not auto-smooth or extend a commodity boom for 15/20 years. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
text.f546c849c4c03cb4e12f: Margins fall 79/74/52/35%, rebound to 38% in years 5–6 and settle at 35% by year 9. This is cycle normalization rather than a single monotonic maturity clock. Prices, not only bits, drove the latest boom.
text.1bd60fbc858aac51c1cb: Gross capex 60/70/55/42/40 bn, cash grants 5/6/4/2/1 bn and D&A 14/18/23/25/26 bn are analytical first-five-year inputs. Late D&A at 18% of sales retains replacement spending. Positive investment persists through contractions. Preserve the disclosed neutral terminal FCFF jump of 6.684%, not a falsely smooth 2% claim.
text.ba5a602d8c2615c018c0: Tax: 15.5%/17%/20% first-three-year cash operating tax then 20% matches the selected fade from near-term guidance to normalized rates. $9.820 bn noncurrent accrued tax is a separate timing obligation; do not assume normalized tax pays it or deduct it twice.
text.041f27b5e077984c9a69: Discount rate: Bounds -1.5/+2 pp map selected 11% to source 9.5/13%. Source base build uses Treasury 5.09%, chosen ERP 4.5%, beta 1.4, debt weight 10%, spread 1.5% and tax shield 20%, yielding 10.7782%, rounded to 11%. All except Treasury are judgments.
text.29a25fe2525261700cb0: Terminal policy: 2% nominal perpetual growth is deliberately more conservative for mature memory. 12% ROIC versus 11% WACC assumes modest differentiated returns, not perpetual scarcity; 16.667% terminal NOPAT must be reinvested. Reported boom ROIC/ROE does not calibrate this.
text.2a95d66a0ea108a91ab0: Three years cover known customer accelerator ramps; ten total years recognize insourcing and architectural change. The $837.7 bn selected mature revenue is already demanding. The 15-year bull remains a separate platform thesis, not a reason for automatic 20-year duration. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
text.2c0a5267618ee4f752eb: 53/55/54% early GAAP EBIT fades to 45% by year 10. Software mix and amortization runoff can support margin, but no assumption removes ongoing SBC, replacement IP or future acquisition costs.
text.ec3603f487da57411546: Capital maturity is unresolved: S:C remains 2 at final explicit year, then terminal 20% ROIC requires more reinvestment. Retain the source -7.168% terminal FCFF step and cash/lease/contingent-credit gates, rather than pretending a mature ratio bridge exists.
text.61bf6600f99048b01188: Tax: 20% normalized operating tax is above near-term ~16% adjusted guidance; FY 2025 discrete negative GAAP tax does not establish a sustainable rate.
text.6a5cbd676159c2857709: Discount rate: Bounds -1/+2 pp recover the explicit 10/13% stress range around 11%. Concentration, contingent finance and cyclicality justify the risk judgment; common Treasury 5.09% is measured, ERP 4.5% chosen, issuer beta/spread unmeasured.
text.8793a8c22b898f6a740c: Terminal policy: 2.5% nominal perpetual growth and 20% ROIC assume durable custom-silicon/networking/software rents but require 12.5% terminal NOPAT reinvestment. Acquisition-distorted book capital and a CEO record are not direct ROIC evidence.
text.d5736ea5b27353f5448b: Five years cover N 2/A 14 and current overseas construction; ten additional years span several node generations while growth fades to 2% in year 15. Fifteen is supported by ecosystem and capital-cycle persistence, not brand alone. Twenty is unsupported; a ten-year compression is a separate stress, not the selected path. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
text.95836b89beafff7cbab4: Margin reaches 46% in year 11 and stays there through year 15, earlier than growth maturity. Overseas dilution is already embedded; do not deduct the management 3–4 pp outlook again.
text.44a51814ab78dbc0001f: Early marginal S:C 1.30/1.25/1.20/1.15/1.10 fades to ~0.489 by year 15. Implied capex/D&A are an audit, not extra FCFF deductions; mature gross capex remains ~TWD 4.323 tr versus D&A 3.616 tr. In a full contraction stress preserve the source 8%-of-revenue positive investment floor. Preserve the neutral 1.751% terminal FCFF step.
text.b752727c71b6c260578d: Tax: 18%/19%/20% first-three-year operating cash tax then 20% is a selected normalization schedule, not a perpetual extrapolation of the latest effective rate. Grants are embedded once in capital economics.
text.f07a32d513bdab30be8e: Discount rate: Bounds -1.5/+3 pp recover native TWD source 8.5/13% around 10%. Source base USD build 11.3182% translates using assumed USD/TWD inflation 2.5/1.5% to TWD 10.2322%, rounded to 10%. Beta 1.2, 10% debt, 1.5% spread/extra equity risk are judgments. It is not a directly observed TWD sovereign yield.
text.0ad1438d2c73921e3f27: Terminal policy: 2% nominal TWD perpetual growth is currency-specific, consistent with assumed long-run TWD inflation 1.5% and modest real growth; not a USD guidance transcription. 18% ROIC supports a durable but fading foundry moat and requires 11.111% terminal NOPAT reinvestment.
text.6373a07ca162be19587e: 210/210 checks passed across all 14 companies. The 160 annual source rows and terminal objects are unchanged; all 368 source-file hashes match. All 56,000 default attempted trials were accepted, with no invalid exclusions. Zero exclusions means the selected bounded settings passed mathematical constraints; it does not establish economic feasibility or calibrate their probabilities.
